Implemented and verified the OBS-1.4 doctor disk group.

## Result report

**Changed files**
- Created `src/doctor/disk-checks.ts` — per-app image sums from `podman images --format json`, BuildKit cache from `podman system df --format json` with a managed `<root>/buildkit/state` fallback, workspace/tools directory sizing, approximate labels, and `null` (= unknown) for unreadable measurements.
- Created `tests/unit/doctor-disk.test.ts` — 21 tests with injected runner and size reader: healthy, warning, failing, unavailable, JSON parity, read-only calls, budget.
- Modified `src/doctor/index.ts` — wires the disk group last, adds `DoctorReport.disk`, `DoctorOptions.appsDir` / `readDirectorySize`, and re-exports disk types.
- Modified `src/doctor/checks.ts` — narrowed `checkDisk` to the two facts it reads so the group reuses one free-space measurement.
- Modified `src/cli/schemas.ts` / `src/cli/json.ts` — additive `disk` object in `doctor --json`, `schemaVersion: 1` retained.
- Modified `tests/unit/json.test.ts` — updated doctor document shape expectations.

**Requirement IDs satisfied**
- OBS-FR-04 (per-app image size, BuildKit cache, workspace usage, 5 GiB warn / 2 GiB fail, approximate labels, same figures in JSON)
- PRE-NF-01 (read-only, local-only, budget-bounded)

**Validation run**
- `npm run typecheck` → exit 0
- `npm run lint` → exit 0
- `npm test -- tests/unit/doctor-disk.test.ts` → 21 passed
- `npm test -- tests/unit/doctor-disk.test.ts tests/unit/doctor.test.ts tests/unit/doctor-build.test.ts tests/unit/json.test.ts` → 90 passed
- `npm test` → 709 passed, 28 files
- `npm run build` → exit 0
- Manual: `node dist/cli/index.js doctor --json` emits one `schemaVersion: 1` document with the `disk` object; human report stays within 80 columns; wall time 1.83 s (< 2 s) on this host.

**Contract change (announce before docs land)**
`doctor --json` gains an additive `disk` object (allowed by OBS-NF-02; no rename/removal, no bump):
`freeBytes`, `totalBytes`, `appImages: [{app, bytes}]`, `imagesTotalBytes`, `buildkitCacheBytes`, `workspaces: [{app, bytes}]`, `workspaceTotalBytes`, `toolsBytes`, `approximate: true`. `null` means “could not be measured”, never zero. The doctor check list and order are unchanged (8 checks, `disk` last).

handoff.summary: Implemented the doctor disk group: per-app image sizes from podman images, BuildKit cache from podman system df with a managed state-directory fallback, workspace/tools sizing, 5 GiB warn and 2 GiB fail thresholds, approximate labels, and identical figures in doctor --json via an additive disk object. Typecheck, lint, 21 focused tests, 90 interaction tests, all 709 unit tests, build, and manual doctor JSON/human checks pass.
decisions: Doctor keeps its eight-check order and runs the disk group last; the usage figures are additive to the existing disk check detail and to a new additive doctor --json disk object.
A podman system df build-cache row is preferred; Podman 5.7 has none, so the managed <root>/buildkit/state directory is measured instead.
Unreadable measurements become null and never change the disk check status; free-space thresholds alone decide pass/warn/fail.
Filesystem walks share one 750 ms group budget and a 200k-entry cap, never follow symlinks, and report later values as unknown rather than overrun the 2-second budget.
Per-app image size is 0 when the image listing succeeded and the app has no image; it is null only when the listing itself failed.
interfaces: parsePodmanImagesJson(output): Map<string, number> | null; parseBuildkitCacheBytes(output): number | null; parseApproximateSize(value); formatApproximateBytes(bytes); describeDiskUsage(usage); readDirectorySize(target)
DoctorDocument.disk (additive in schemaVersion 1): freeBytes, totalBytes, appImages, imagesTotalBytes, buildkitCacheBytes, workspaces, workspaceTotalBytes, toolsBytes, approximate
tests: npm test -- tests/unit/doctor-disk.test.ts tests/unit/doctor.test.ts tests/unit/doctor-build.test.ts tests/unit/json.test.ts: 90 passed
manual doctor --json and human report: one schemaVersion 1 document with disk figures, 80-column human output, wall 1.83s
warnings: The additive doctor --json disk object must be reflected by the CLI/config reference docs; schemaVersion stays 1 because nothing was renamed or removed.
Measurement unavailability never fails doctor; a host with healthy free space still passes the disk check even when image/cache/workspace sizes are unknown.
On this host no easy-host app images existed, so the live manual run reported 0-byte easy-host image usage; per-app image sums are proven by recorded Podman JSON fixtures.
validationLimitations: No real easy-host image or gated Podman integration suite was exercised; Podman output was injected, while workspace/tools/cache filesystem paths were real temporary directories.
The manual doctor run exits 2 because Railpack and BuildKit are absent on this host; that is host state, not a disk-reporting failure.
The 2-second budget is asserted with an injected clock and observed at 1.83s wall time on this host; no healthy-host run with Railpack and BuildKit installed was available.
